name: Satoshi Dashboard
description: Satoshi Dashboard is a comprehensive, real-time Bitcoin analytics platform that brings together 32+ key metrics into a single, beautifully designed interface. Track live BTC price, sats per dollar, block height, hash rate, network difficulty, circulating supply, and the Fear & Greed index — all updating in real time from multiple data sources.
author: Satoshi-Dashboard
